sans.$description: The Pro theme's UI font. Each theme swaps the family (Blue=Inter, Pro=Rubik, Gold=Exo, Alien=Jost) — baked to Rubik here. Rubik ships a Cyrillic subset, which the product needs (bet content is Russian/Ukrainian), unlike the previous Latin-only Sora.

semibold.$description: heading-* styles (headings at body sizes). 500 is Rubik Medium — the Pro theme's 'semibold' step; the token name is kept for continuity across themes even though the value is 500 here.

bold.$description: title-* and label-* styles — the strong step (Rubik ExtraBold), for team names, odds, section titles.

base.$description: The product's default UI text size (this is an app, not a marketing site) — deliberately 14px, not the 16px 'base' convention from Tailwind/browser defaults. Same pattern as Linear/Stripe Dashboard/Notion.

4xl.$description: Not consumed by any text-style yet — headroom for e.g. a stat-tile hero number.

5xl.$description: Not consumed by any text-style yet — headroom for e.g. a stat-tile hero number.

leading.$description: Unitless ratios (CSS best practice for line-height — a percentage/px value inherits into children unexpectedly; unitless doesn't). 1.4 = the Figma source's 140%, etc.

wide.$description: Added for all-caps label styles — caps text at 0 tracking reads cramped; ~0.04em is a standard fix (Material uses ~0.05em for overline/caps).
